archetypes.name: dyn-fence-trailer-grammar
archetypes.rationale: Shared fence and trailer grammar changes can silently diverge across plan, issue, and OOS parsers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect plan_grammar._balanced_fence_line_indices and its use in iter_heading_events, issue_create.parse_issue_input, and file_oos._validate_issue_cap_input. Confirm unmatched openers do not hide later headings, closers require same marker with whitespace-only suffix, and Preflight _RECOGNIZED_TRAILER_PREFIX_RE is built only from TRAILER_KEYS while value validation stays in match_trailer_line. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
